name: Kil'hala
summary: At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Kil'hala teaches Horde tailors the work of cloth. Young Horde mages also bring him locks of hair from Ashenvale's laughing sisters, and he weaves them into nether-lace robes.

sections.title: Tailor of the Barrens
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Kil'hala teaches tailors from among the Horde recruits and travelers. He shows them how to work common spun bolts and make garments for life on the dry plains. At Deino's request, he also weaves nether-lace robes for young mages who bring him hair from the laughing sisters, the dryads of Ashenvale's forests.

faq.answer: Kil'hala is a Darkspear troll who trains tailors at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He teaches Horde tradesfolk to weave cloth and make garments.
Kil'hala can be found at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He is among the other Horde trade trainers.

faq.q: What tasks does Kil'hala give to tailors?
faq.answer: Kil'hala sends no tailors out himself. Young Horde mages sent by Deino bring him locks of hair from the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Ashenvale's Raynewood Retreat. He weaves the hair into a nether-lace garment for them.

angles.text: As a Horde tailor, you can learn the craft from Kil'hala at the Crossroads. He also weaves exotic magical robes.
At the Crossroads, Kil'hala teaches clothworking and provides goods for Horde warbands and travelers making a foothold in the Barrens.
